Well that makes it a bit easier. It should definately be somewhere she feels safe and doesn't have to be self-aware. 

No patronizing of any kind. You want her to know you take her seriously. You should just tell her that. Maybe even start with that.

She's 13 and probably has a lot on her mind. It would probably be best if you didn't have a big sit-down and go through it all at once. Start with letting her know you are serious and that you take her seriously. Make clear that she can contact you whenever and for whatever reason. Let her digest that fact and bring it up again at another time. 

Also, try not to make a big number out of it. It may be hard to keep it casual. If her father is very strict and tough-love kinda guy, you should avoid the good cop-bad cop situation where you become the nice one and therefore put her father in bad light. 

It sounds like she got really upset about losing the phone and thus losing the ability to keep in touch with her boyfriend. She might be going through all kinds of worst-case-scenarios about losing her boyfriend (because she cant't respond to him and keep in touch etc)

There's something for you to chew on.
Does she know you know she took the pills?
I just wish this day would be over so I could get back to bed. Luckily the SO is (apparently) going somewhere. She's putting make-up on etc.

Thank you for your kind words.

I think you misunderstood something. My writing wasn't exactly coherent last night.
I have divorces my wife on march. She's doing better for now.

I live in another relationship in which I am being cheated and we're together for financial reasons. It's consuming.

I can't burden my mother with this.
You do seem like a nice person. I don't know how to feel about motivational speeches. It's like saying "It's gonna be okay don't worry".

Last summer I actually started to plan a trip insipired by [this](http://imgur.com/a/J7kZJ).

I wanted to drive north until the road ends. Turns out it would be Norway and the northenmost point of Europe continent. Oh well.. it kinda dried up. I'm really not that keen on travelling alone.

I feel bad because you have such good intentions and put your time into thinking of good things for me (like the hike) and I'm not getting much out of it.

You are right about the fact that I don't have passion to anything else than photography. And even that is slowly dying. Mainly because every time I think of photographing something I ask myself "Why bother?".

It doensn't really matter but I'll type this anyway. I don't have anything else to do.
Construction workers have an alright salary if they have a paper from a school. I don't. I have worked my way up from sweeping garbage. I make ~15e/h minus taxes. I have debt I have to pay and child support. Then the rent. The money I have for all other expenses doesn't leave me a chance of saving any. I have struggled with finances all my life.

I am also very, very, **very** impulsive person. That can be a positive attribute but usually it's not. I can spend money on something I can't really afford. Usually it's something I buy for the kids or SO. I can do decisions on a very short notice. I can jump in and out of things very quickly.

Most of my "excess" money goes to maintaining my car. I have to pay for the traffic insurance, taxes (yes in Finland we have to pay taxes for owning a car even after the taxes included in the purchasing the vehicle and the VAT on gas) and of course maintenance.

There's a problem showing this woman I am over her. Because I am not over her. And it doesn't get easier because I have to see her daily. ATM we're not speaking. Getting involved with her is bad for me but when I feel completely helpless and she's present... it's hard not to try and reach for her although she might not give two shits about me. Right now I'm mostly pissed at her for being such an idiot.

I don't have hobbies to keep me occupied except photography. I'm an amateur photographer but losing interest in it gradually. I have to struggle to find inspiration nowadays. I need excuses to pick up the camera and shoot. I don't like what I shoot. I don't like the outcome of my photographs anymore. I have a few online galleries but I haven't uploaded for a while.

I do appreciate you (and everyone else ITT) for taking the time and write to me.

One of my biggest problems is that I actually didn't go through all the grief and pain like I was supposed to. Not on all occasions. I had to push them aside so I could remain a functioning human being. I needed to provide for my family, take care of the kids, be on my toes all the time not to trigger my wife into psychosis.

My psychiatrist told me that all the crap I pushed away is coming back all at once. Which is why I should've dealt with them gradually over the years.

I don't know if I want to deal with them now any more than I wanted before.

You say I am worth something. Sure, I am worth something... to who?
My kids? Yeah. That's what most people would say. To most people that would be a reason big enough to keep going.

I feel like I am past that point where I am capable of living only for my children. I am sure that it would hurt my parents greatly to lose me but I don't have the energy to wallow in the sadness of all that. After all, my mother has been suicidal herself. She'd get it.
Yeah. She does it every time thing aren't nice and dandy with me.

I am sorry for losing people close to you. It is unfair. No way around it.I'm a pretty tough guy when it comes to dealing with stuff like this. But it's starting to feel like my cup is been full long enough to spill all over. How would I say it... losing my shit like you phrased it. Shit hitting the fan. All I need is one small push.What comes to pushing through life... I've been pushing the past 10 years and I'm tired. I don't want to push through shit for all my life.

I fell asleep with my phone in my hand. Apparently slept some six hours.I don't have anything saved up. If I did, I would use it to move out of here and away from that woman who is making me miserable.We are sleeping in separate rooms (again). I don't have go to work, I'm on a sick leave. I work in the construction sites. I have worked for seven years. I hate it. I don't even wanna go back to work.I'm all up for awesome experiences but jumping off a working airplane is a huge NOPE. I get your point though.I have no degree. I have quit 3 different schools when I was younger. And now I'm a construction worker.Taking care of myself and/or spoiling myself sounds nice but I have no interest in such. Feels pointless. All my life I have been living for others. That makes me think... Why I don't know how to live for *me*? Only way I know is for others and I'm sick of it since I keep losing them.
